_doc: Maps each supported artifact to its parser file, offline parser, output database, and (when available) its visual-anatomy reference page on https://crow-eye.com/eye-describe . The Eye Agent reads anatomy_url whenever it needs to explain the BINARY-LEVEL STRUCTURE of an artifact (offsets, field widths, signature bytes, on-disk layout). Knowledge .md files in this directory cover the SEMANTIC and FORENSIC questions; the anatomy pages cover the byte-level layout.

prefetch.description: Windows Prefetch file parser for program execution evidence
prefetch.anatomy_summary: Interactive byte-level walk of a .pf file: SCCA header, file version (Win 8/10/11 differences), executable name UTF-16 block, file metrics array, trace chains, volume info block with run_times array, and directory strings.

mft.description: Master File Table parser for NTFS file system metadata
mft.anatomy_summary: Byte-level walk of an MFT record: FILE0/FILE* signature, fixup array, sequence number, hard-link count, attribute list ($STANDARD_INFORMATION, $FILE_NAME, $DATA), MACB timestamps in $SIA vs $FNA streams, resident vs non-resident attributes, data runs.

amcache.description: Amcache.hve parser for application execution tracking
amcache.anatomy_summary: Visual anatomy page not yet published.

shimcache.anatomy_summary: Byte-level walk of the AppCompatCache registry value: signature, entry-count header, per-entry layout (path length, path UTF-16, last-modified FILETIME, insertion flags, executed flag), and the Windows-version differences (Win7/8/10/11) that change entry size and field order.

registry.anatomy_summary: Visual anatomy page not yet published.

usn.description: USN Journal parser for NTFS change log
usn.anatomy_summary: Byte-level walk of a USN journal record: record length, major/minor version, file reference number, parent reference number, USN sequence, timestamp, reason flags (FILE_CREATE / FILE_DELETE / RENAME bitmask), source info, security ID, file attributes, file-name length + UTF-16 name.

jumplist.description: Jump List and LNK file parser
jumplist.anatomy_summary: Three complementary pages. AutomaticDestinations: OLE compound document (MS-CFB) with DestList stream + per-entry LNK substreams. CustomDestinations: header + entry blocks each containing a full LNK shortcut. LNK Anatomy: ShellLinkHeader, LinkTargetIDList, LinkInfo, StringData (name/relative/working/arguments/icon), extra data blocks (Tracker, Console, EnvironmentVariableDataBlock, etc.).

recyclebin.anatomy_summary: Visual anatomy page not yet published.

srum.anatomy_summary: Visual anatomy page not yet published.

eventlog.anatomy_summary: Visual anatomy page not yet published.

anatomy_index._doc: Quick lookup: artifact_key -> anatomy_url. Use this when the user / agent asks 'how is artifact X structured at the byte level' — fetch the URL for a guided visual walkthrough.
